**SCALE — CHARACTERS MUST BE TINY:** Manuel and Franziska together occupy NO MORE than 1/8 of the frame height, feet to head. They are distant silhouettes at the lakeshore, NOT foreground portraits. Do NOT paint their faces in detail — they are too far away to see features. If you catch yourself drawing large figures, SHRINK THEM.

**REQUIRED OBJECT — SMALL ROWBOAT IN MIDGROUND:** A small wooden rowboat must be visible on the churning lake, in the left midground, pushing away from shore. Three figures inside: one rowing (soldier), one seated in the stern (soldier), one seated in the middle (Roger, the prisoner — no weapons, hands visible, passive). The boat is small, the figures within it even smaller than Manuel/Franziska on shore. Rain partially obscures the boat.

**NO CROWD AT THE SHORE OR ON THE DOCK.** Only Manuel + Franziska at the water's edge. Any dock is EMPTY.
